title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Transfer Amount
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the bank transfer amount of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account.**

## The amount

The bank transfer amount is the lowest of the bank percentage room, the bank pay-period room, the bank day room, the tier's largest single transfer and, where it applies, the bank deduction-ceiling room; it is never below zero and is rounded down to the cent.

## The quantities

- **Bank percentage room** — the bank transfer percentage, divided by one hundred, times the bank accrued net, less the bank period taken. The bank transfer percentage is the tier's access percentage.
- **Bank pay-period room** — the tier's pay-period dollar ceiling less the bank period taken.
- **Bank day room** — the tier's daily dollar ceiling less the amount of every transfer booked on the plan today, returned or not.
- **Bank deduction-ceiling room** — where the worker has a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan in status repaying whose next installment date equals the plan's next payday: the tier's combined deduction ceiling percentage, divided by one hundred, times the period's accrued net as the base accrual rule measures it, each sync line that rule counts at its recorded net amount, less the correction lines, less the bank period taken, less that loan's installment amount. Without such a loan there is no bank deduction-ceiling room.
- **Bank period taken** — the amount of the plan's transfers carrying the current payday, the plan's next payday, less the amount of the plan's transfer returns carrying that payday.
- **Bank accrued net** — the net amount of the plan's earnings sync lines carrying the current payday less the net amount of its earnings correction lines carrying that payday, each line at its recorded net amount, regular-hours lines always counting, overtime lines only where the tier counts overtime, shift-differential lines only where the tier counts shift differential and card tips lines only where the tier counts card tips; on a tier whose earnings availability lag is one day, sync and correction lines whose work date is today do not count.
- **Open shortfall** — the plan's outstanding balance less the bank period taken less the amount of the plan's fees carrying the current payday net of the fee reversals carrying that payday. While it is above zero, the bank transfer percentage and the tier's pay-period dollar ceiling are each multiplied by the tier's share of access kept while a shortfall is open, divided by one hundred, when it does not exceed the tier's largest tolerated open shortfall, and by zero when it does.

Toward the bank percentage room and the bank pay-period room a returned or cancelled transfer does not count, and toward the bank day room every transfer booked on the plan today counts, returned or not.

**Order of operation.** Adjustments are applied in this order: any that adds to the tier's access percentage first, then any that multiplies the bank transfer percentage, together with the open-shortfall multiplier, and last any that multiplies the lowest of the rooms, before the amount is rounded down.

## Worked example (hypothetical plan on Paystride Access Plus, no repaying loan)

- Earnings lines carrying the current payday, work dates before today: regular hours 410.00, shift differential 32.50, overtime 58.00 and card tips 21.40 USD, less a correction of 15.00 USD. A regular-hours line worked today, 52.00 USD, does not count on this one-day-lag tier. Bank accrued net: 506.90 USD.
- Transfers carrying the payday 87.40 USD, of which 22.40 USD returned: bank period taken 65.00 USD.
- Outstanding balance 69.98 USD and fees carrying the payday 4.98 USD: open shortfall zero, so no multiplier applies.
- Bank percentage room: 40 divided by one hundred times 506.90, 202.76, less 65.00: 137.76 USD. Bank pay-period room: 500.00 less 65.00, 435.00 USD. Bank day room: nothing booked today, 250.00 USD. Largest single transfer: 200.00 USD.
- Bank transfer amount: the lowest, **137.76 USD**.

*Same plan with a repaying loan whose installment of 120.00 USD falls on the next payday:* the deduction-ceiling room is 50 divided by one hundred times 506.90, 253.45, less 65.00, less 120.00: 68.45 USD, which becomes the lowest room and the amount.
